text:
tess: Quick concept: 'Prompt Quickstart Surge' 1-week PLG push — live 30m demo + downloadable prompt pack + 120 credits. Objective: boost signup -> first-generate to 40% within 48h. :zap:

sam: Nice. Primary metric = first-generate in 48h. Secondary = day7 retention and average tokens/use.

olivia: Routing/ops Q: should webinar registrants be auto-enrolled into a 'quickstart' promo cohort and get credits immediately? I can wire promo API if we standardize the promo id.

noah: Recommend two experiment arms: 120 credits + prompt pack vs 120 credits + guided console tour that highlights runnable templates. N = ~350 per arm.

chris: I'll prepare 3 launch post drafts (dev-focused, tutorial-focused, benchmark blurb). Also a short benchmark sidebar: typical latency for a 512-token prompt on hosted endpoint and cost delta vs our quantized variant. Link to mockups: https://figma.com/s/quickstart-surge

sam: Tracking: utm_campaign=quickstart-surge, utm_medium=social/newsletter, add Amplitude events: webinar_reg, promo_issued, first_generate. Exclude corporate domains from auto-credits.

tess: Communication copy idea: 'Run real prompts in minutes 120 credits + runnable templates at signup. Join live or catch on-demand.' Keep CTA clear.

olivia: I'll create the automation flow: webhook->issue promo via /v1/internal/promos/issue -> email with direct "Run this prompt" button. Need final copy + promo id by EOD Wed.

noah: Also propose a tiny nudge sequence: 1) immediate email with template pack, 2) 12h reminder highlighting a sample snippet to run, 3) 48h follow-up with tips. Measure open->first-generate conversion for each email.

chris: Posting plan: day-of launch socials + partner newsletter. I'll post copy variants; we can A/B headline and the hero image (technical vs hands-on).

tess: Final checklist: socials & blog blurb (chris), promo + emails (olivia), webhook routing (sam), experiment arms + metrics (noah), assets ready by Thu morning. Sync 11am PT tomorrow for 15m.

event-bot: Webinar scheduled: Prompt Quickstart Surge on 2025-08-12 18:00 UTC. Registration: https://redwood.ai/webinar/quickstart-surge

tess: Cool 15m sync tomorrow. Keep it lightweight so we can iterate fast.
